title: Farrerol inhibits ferroptosis and protects against LPS-induced acute lung injury by targeting the RUNX1/SLC7A11 axis.
authors: Yang, Yueyan; Deng, Shihua; Liu, Teng; Yin, Qing; Yang, Min; Zhang, Xintao; Jiang, Zhongyong; Wang, Xiaobian; Zhang, Sunhan; Zhang, Ting; Wu, Dongming; Xu, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Farrerol通过靶向RUNX1/SLC7A11轴抑制铁死亡并保护LPS诱导的急性肺损伤，涉及RUNX1转录因子与DNA结合调控，但核心是疾病治疗机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上仅用分子对接辅助，缺乏AI或物理模拟的深度建模。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a critical condition with diverse etiologies, characterized by high mortality rates and a lack of specific therapeutic interventions. Farrerol, a naturally occurring flavonoid isolated from Rhododendron spp., exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Previous studies have indicated that farrerol exerts protective effects against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI; however, the underlying mechanisms remain elusive. This study aimed to elucidate the protective mechanisms of farrerol against LPS-induced ALI. METHODS: We evaluated the efficacy of farrerol using both in vitro (LPS-stimulated BEAS-2B cells) and in vivo (LPS-induced ALI in mice) models. The protective mechanism of rhododendron against ALI was investigated using proteomics, cellular thermal shift assays, co-immunoprecipitation, and molecular docking. RESULTS: Pretreatment with farrerol significantly improved cell viability and reduced lactate dehydrogenase release in LPS-induced BEAS-2B cells. In vivo, farrerol effectively alleviated LPS-induced pulmonary edema and histopathological damage in mice. Mechanistically, we found that farrerol directly binds to and stabilizes runt-related transcription factor 1 (RUNX1), thereby transcriptionally activating the expression of solute carrier family 7 member 11. Overexpression of RUNX1 mimicked the protective effects of farrerol, while knockdown of RUNX1 abolished these effects. DISCUSSION: Farrerol could directly bind and stabilize the expression of RUNX1, thereby enhancing SLC7A11 transcription and ultimately inhibiting ferroptosis. Thus, farrerol is a potential therapeutic agent for ALI.
abstract_zh: 引言：急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种病因多样、死亡率高且缺乏特异性治疗干预的危重疾病。法雷洛尔（Farrerol）是一种从杜鹃花属（Rhododendron spp.）中分离的天然类黄酮，具有强效的抗炎和抗氧化活性。既往研究表明，法雷洛尔对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI具有保护作用；然而，其潜在机制仍不明确。本研究旨在阐明法雷洛尔对LPS诱导ALI的保护机制。方法：我们使用体外（LPS刺激的BEAS-2B细胞）和体内（小鼠LPS诱导ALI）模型评估了法雷洛尔的疗效。通过蛋白质组学、细胞热位移分析、免疫共沉淀和分子对接技术，研究了杜鹃花对ALI的保护机制。结果：法雷洛尔预处理显著提高了LPS诱导BEAS-2B细胞的细胞活力，并减少了乳酸脱氢酶释放。在体内，法雷洛尔有效减轻了小鼠LPS诱导的肺水肿和组织病理学损伤。机制上，我们发现法雷洛尔直接结合并稳定runt相关转录因子1（RUNX1），从而转录激活溶质载体家族7成员11的表达。RUNX1过表达模拟了法雷洛尔的保护作用，而RUNX1敲低则消除了这些效应。讨论：法雷洛尔可直接结合并稳定RUNX1的表达，从而增强SLC7A11转录，最终抑制铁死亡。因此，法雷洛尔是ALI的潜在治疗药物。
